# TikTok.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/tiktok-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/tiktok-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects data from tiktok.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How To Scrape TikTok in 2025](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-tiktok-python-json)
- **Code:** [`tiktok.py`](tiktok.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Comment data](results/comments.json) · [Post data](results/posts.json) · [Profile data](results/profiles.json) · [Channel data](results/channel.json) · [Search data](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- TikTok post pages for post/video data.
- TikTok comments for comment data on a specific post/video.
- TikTok profile pages for profile data.
- TikTok channel pages for video data.
- TikTok search pages for video data on search results. It can scrape profiles as well.

## Functions

- `scrape_posts(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape tiktok posts data from their URLs
- `scrape_comments(post_url)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape comments from tiktok posts from xhr call parsing
- `scrape_profiles(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape tiktok profiles data from their URLs
- `scrape_search(keyword)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape tiktok search data by scrolling the search page
- `scrape_channel(url)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape video data from a channel (profile with videos)

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import tiktok


async def main():
    posts = await tiktok.scrape_posts(
        urls=["https://www.tiktok.com/@oddanimalspecimens/video/7198206283571285294"],
    )
    comments = await tiktok.scrape_comments(
        post_url="https://www.tiktok.com/@oddanimalspecimens/video/7198206283571285294",
    )
    profiles = await tiktok.scrape_profiles(urls=["https://www.tiktok.com/@oddanimalspecimens"])
    search = await tiktok.scrape_search(keyword="whales")
    channel = await tiktok.scrape_channel(url="https://www.tiktok.com/@oddanimalspecimens")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/comments.json`](results/comments.json): `text`, `comment_language`, `digg_count`, `reply_comment_total`, `author_pin`, `create_time`, `cid`, `nickname`, `unique_id`, `aweme_id`
- [`results/posts.json`](results/posts.json): `id`, `desc`, `createTime`, `video`, `author`, `stats`, `locationCreated`, `diversificationLabels`, `suggestedWords`, `contents`
- [`results/profiles.json`](results/profiles.json): `user`, `stats`, `statsV2`, `itemList`
- [`results/channel.json`](results/channel.json): `createTime`, `desc`, `id`, `stats`, `contents`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `desc`, `createTime`, `video`, `author`, `stats`, `authorStats`, `type`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`tiktok.py`](tiktok.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"AU"`: country of the proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/tiktok-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_comment_scraping`, `test_post_scraping`, `test_profile_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_channel_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
